figurative_meaning_en: Fortunate person, one blessed with good luck
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কপালে উঁচু বলেই সে সবসময় সফল হয়।
কপালে উঁচু ছেলেটি লটারিতে জিতে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is always successful because he has a high forehead.
The boy with a high forehead won the lottery.
history: Rooted in ancient Indian physiognomy (সামুদ্রিক শাস্ত্র) where forehead shape was believed to indicate destiny and prosperity.
note: This idiom draws from traditional beliefs in facial features determining fate, common in Bengali folklore.
